text: {"summary":"Verified and finalized the aomi-app-ux-tool-maker curation of apps/geckoterminal for the GeckoTerminal price-data user story. The tool layer at apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs is a hand-curated set of 11 user-centric tools (down from 20 mechanical endpoint stubs) wrapping the app-local progenitor client: geckoterminal_get_token_price (batch spot prices with 24h change/volume/mcap), geckoterminal_get_pool_ohlcv (price/volume candle history), geckoterminal_get_token (composite: token profile + top pools in one call), geckoterminal_search_pools (symbol/pair → pool address resolution), geckoterminal_get_pool, geckoterminal_get_pool_trades (whale-filterable), geckoterminal_get_trending_pools, geckoterminal_get_top_pools, geckoterminal_get_new_pools, geckoterminal_check_token_safety (GT score/honeypot/holder-concentration signals), and geckoterminal_list_networks for ID discovery. Dropped endpoints: pool token info (overlaps safety check), recently-updated token metadata (niche), and multi-token data (overlaps batch price). All tools are verb-led, ≤5 args, with 'Use when…' descriptions; the PREAMBLE in lib.rs is domain-specific with conventions (network slugs, string-typed numerics, ~10 calls/min rate limit, JSON:API response shape), workflow guidance (search→pool-address→deep-dive chaining), and formatting rules, and is consistent with the shipped tool list. Verification: cargo build passes clean; live-API smoke test confirmed the base URL and response shapes for the simple token_price and networks endpoints (WETH priced at $1842.73 with 24h vol/change fields as expected). test.json already contained a user_story seed ('trending pools on Base, deep-dive the top one with price, volume, liquidity, and $10k+ trades') and was preserved per skill policy. No ext/ files were needed — the app uses an app-local spec (apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml) and generated client (src/client/), and the public API requires no auth shim.
